thread:
jessica_cs: Quick heads up — noticed healthscore drift in the trial cohort after yesterday's CRM export. Unknown 'last_touch' jumped from ~6% to 24% for new trials. Did playbook runner execute?
ken_support: Yeah we got a few manual escalations this morning, customers asking why they didn't get onboarding nudge. :eyes:
ali_data: Ran a narrow query, looks like owner_id went null for records where external_id had trailing spaces in the CSV. Quick snippet:```sql
SELECT id, owner_id, external_id FROM contacts WHERE external_id LIKE '% ' AND owner_id IS NULL LIMIT 50;
```
jessica_cs: ugh, that explains a lot. Which pipeline handles trimming? Import lambda?
ali_data: The legacy import step forgot a trim in the staging transform after recent schema tweak. I can patch but need to coordinate with playbook automation — we shouldn't retrigger every playbook run on those records.
playbook-bot: WARNING: playbook-runner (v2.3.1) failed 1/3 webhooks for rule "onboard-nudge" — target returned 502. Retry scheduled in 30s.
taylor_enable: We've got ~120 invites queued that rely on the nudge webhook. If playbook reruns on all affected contacts we'll double-send. Can we put the nudge rule into a dry-run mode?
dave_se: I pushed a hotfix branch to stop mass triggers: https://github.com/redwood/realtime/pull/482 — it adds idempotency keys for playbook webhook calls and trims external_id at staging.
ken_support: Thanks, Dave. Can ops hold the playbook queue while we run the one-off cleanup?
dave_se: Yes, I can flip the flag on the playbook scheduler to pause outbound pushes for the rule. ETA 10 mins.
ali_data: I'll prepare a safe cleanup script that updates external_id = RTRIM(external_id) and backfills owner_id from the owner_mapping table for matches. Sample update:```sql
UPDATE contacts c SET external_id = RTRIM(c.external_id) WHERE external_id LIKE '% ';
UPDATE contacts c SET owner_id = m.owner_id FROM owner_mapping m WHERE c.external_id = m.external_id AND c.owner_id IS NULL;
```
jessica_cs: After cleanup, can we run a scoped playbook dry-run on a 50-record sample and confirm no duplicate invites?
taylor_enable: Yep I can run dry-run and validate email-sent logs. Tag me when ready.
playbook-bot: DRY-RUN report (onboard-nudge) queued by taylor_enable for sample set id=crmsample-2024-03-05. Expected sends: 50, predicted duplicates: 0
dave_se: Paused outbound rule, applying cleanup now. Will post when complete.
(10 minutes later)
dave_se: Cleanup done. Trimmed 842 records, backfilled 780 owner_ids. Playbook queue is still paused.
ali_data: Verified owner mapping for a 100-record sample — all good. No unexpected nulls.
taylor_enable: Dry-run complete: 50 sample sends, 0 duplicates, 0 error webhooks. Looks good to re-enable with idempotency in place.
jessica_cs: Great. Next steps: 1) merge PR 482, 2) re-enable outbound rule in 15 after monitoring window, 3) run backfill monitor job and set alert if unknown last_touch > 5% for 24h. I'll create an Ops ticket.
ken_support: I'll draft the customer messaging for the small cohort that was delayed.
dave_se: Merged and deploying now. Will hold on re-enable until you give thumbs.
jessica_cs: Thumbs when ready. Thanks everyone — big reduction in noise once this is closed. :tada:
